Pre-condition: Employee logged in, leave balance allocated
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Employee Dashboard
2. Click on Leave menu
3. Verify Leave Balance section
4. Check balance values
5. Verify visual display
Expected Result: All allocated leave types displayed with correct balance (Total, Used, Available)

Test Steps:
1. Click Apply Leave tab
2. Select leave type (Casual Leave)
3. Enter start date (today+3)
4. Enter end date (today+5)
5. Verify days calculation (3 days)
6. Enter reason
7. Click Submit
8. Switch to My Leaves tab
9. Verify balance unchanged (pending)
Expected Result: Request submitted successfully, appears in My Leaves with Pending status
Notes:
Leave Type: Casual Leave
Days: 3
Reason: Family function

2. Enter date range exceeding balance
